text:
maya: :rotating_light: Heads-up — multiple support tickets and an intercom thread reporting 400s from embeddings endpoint since ~2026-03-15T12:10:00Z. Customers report "dimension mismatch" errors and elevated latency. Pasting sample error and a quick repro below. @alex can you take?

alex: Oncall here — I'll triage. Which model and region? Any correlation with Dedicated vs Hosted?

maya: Mainly hosted API, model=embed-large-v1 (customer says expected dim 1536 but response error shows 2048). Region us-west-2 and eu-west-1 both impacted. Attach sample error from prod logs: 

```
ERROR 2026-03-15T12:12:03Z embed-service req_id=abc123 status=400 msg="embedding dimension mismatch" details="expected=1536 got=2048 batch_id=2026-03-15T12:12:02Z" customer_id=acme-inc
```

alex: Thanks. Can you repro locally? Any changes rolled in recently to batching/quantization?

maya: Support repro steps from customer (sanitized):

1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"model":"embed-large-v1","input":"hello world"}'
2) Many requests return 200 with embedding of length 1536. Some return 400: 

```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 2048"}
```

alex: I'm seeing a spike in batch errors on the embed-batcher. Asking metrics-bot to pull p95 and error rate for /v1/embeddings in last 60m.

metrics-bot: p95 latency for embeddings endpoint (1h): 420ms (baseline 95ms). Error rate (4xx) increased from 0.2% to 6.4% starting 12:08 UTC.

alex: Noted. @sophie @jordan any recent deploys to embed-batcher or routing?

sophie: We had a small change to batching logic rolled two hours ago — a flag that allows batcher to combine requests across compatible models to improve GPU utilization (feature flag: combine_compatible_models=false -> true). We turned it on at 10:13 UTC to test throughput improvements.

jordan: That change was intended to only combine models with identical tokenization and embedding dims, but I see the safety check relied on model_name prefix matching. A newer model (embed-large-v1) has an alternate alias (embed-large-v1-2048) that confused the matcher. The batcher mixed requests for 1536-dim and 2048-dim variants into the same batch leading to post-inference validation failing.

alex: That explains dimension mismatch. Short-term mitigation options: 1) flip combine_compatible_models=false 2) abort current running batches 3) route traffic to fallback model variant (embed-small) until fix. Which is fastest?

sophie: Toggling the feature flag is easiest. Doing a config flip on the batcher via admin API now.

```
# internal-admin api
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/flags/combine_compatible_models -d '{"value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

deploy-bot: feature-flag-update: combine_compatible_models -> false by sophie at 2026-03-15T12:29:12Z (patch)

alex: After toggle, I'm seeing error rate drop in a few minutes. metrics-bot, please confirm 5m window.

metrics-bot: 5m window (12:30-12:35): error rate down to 0.4%, p95 latency 130ms.

maya: Support confirms customers seeing successful calls again. One customer reported transient failures for 2-3 minutes — offered to issue credits.

jordan: Root cause: model aliasing caused matcher to combine incompatible dims. I'm opening a follow-up PR to add explicit model-dim metadata in catalog and have the batcher check dims, not just name prefixes. Also adding unit tests for aliasing cases.

alex: Good. Can we also add alerting rule for spikes in embedding-dimension-errors so oncall is notified before customer tickets escalate?

sophie: Yep - I'll add an alert on the 4xx dimension-mismatch error count > 1% for 5 minutes per-region and a runbook that includes immediate flag rollback and routing to fallback.

oncall-bot: Escalation created: INC-2026-embeddings-dim-mismatch-1810001110 assigned to alex. Priority P2.

alex: Postmortem items I'll own: (1) permanent fix to batcher model-dim checks (PR in progress), (2) alert + runbook, (3) retro on the combine_compatible_models rollout process and improving canary logic.

maya: Support follow-up: emailing affected customers with RCA and offering 10% credits for request errors during window 12:08-12:32 UTC.

jordan: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/eng/embed-batcher/pulls/789 (draft). Deploy plan: add strict dim check, unit tests, canary to 5% traffic for 30m, then full rollout.

alex: Thanks everyone. Summary: cause=batcher combining incompatible model aliases -> dimension mismatch 1536 vs 2048; mitigation=feature-flag rollback; customer impact=brief errors and latency spike; action items assigned. Closing when PR merged and alerts created. :thumbsup:
